name: Dead Space
notes: Frostbite DX12 → D3DMetal (Control class). This is the 2023 remake (1693980), not the 2008 original. Launch Dead Space.exe with SteamAppId=1693980. Ray tracing is DXR via D3DMetal on M3/M4; DLSS cannot run on Apple Silicon. EA App overlay is not required for the Steam build. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
